about.founder.label: FOUNDER & LEAD
about.founder.bio: Marwa Habibi is an Afghan human rights activist and journalist whose work spans independent reporting, documentary translation, poetry, and public speaking. Her writing and interviews have appeared through the BBC World Service, Afghanistan International, Amu TV, and independent literary platforms. She founded Just Women Can Change Society to create space for Afghan women's voices in media, education, and storytelling.
